<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite>, beg. <he>פ׳ ביה שידא וכ׳</he> the demon Sh’madon met him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 61:9">Yalk. ib. 61</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>פ׳ ליה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 99b:18">B. Kam. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּגְעוּ ביה</he> … <he>גברא</he> R. K. and R. A. met that man.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:12:10">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>יאות עביד דלא פ׳ ביה</he> he did right not to connect himself with that man.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:12:10">Ib.</cite> top <he>דלא תִפְגַּע בהון</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01243"><he>פְּסוּלָא</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 58">Gen. R. s. 58</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 102:17">Yalk. ib. 102</cite> <he>פַּגְעוּנֵיה</he>, v. <cite ref="O01647"><he>סְרַס</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to happen. Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ bot. ומִתְפְּגַע ביה and it happened to him (he died).
